name: mp4ff
reason: The upstream mp4ff 0.62.1 is a Go module with Go command-line tools, and its Homebrew formula installs those tools. No C or C++ library API is documented; the Go package is evaluated in the Go MP4 cell.

name: mp4box
reason: Homebrew mp4box resolves to the gpac formula and MP4Box is its CLI; the GPAC library package is counted once.

name: qtmultimedia
reason: Homebrew qtmultimedia 6.12.0_1 exposes QMediaPlayer local-file API, but the installed macOS package reports only the darwin media backend; a QGuiApplication control run stayed at LoadingMedia (status 1) for eight seconds and returned zero tracks, zero duration, and no title. No format-aware control result was verified. Homebrew requested-install count is 1,584 (365-day snapshot), a candidate adoption signal only.
